h1: Honest support. A choice that is yours.
lead: A student-first approach to finding your next chapter in Australia.

image.alt: Student life and learning in Australia (illustrative image)

principles: Your goals, your situation and your questions guide the conversation.
We aim to make your next step easy to understand. We check information, explain what is not confirmed yet, and the choice stays yours.
We work online. Contact the team to arrange a time to talk.
We use modern digital tools to research options and keep things moving. Decisions that need a professional are always made by the right qualified person.
storyH2: Started in Sydney in 2023. Built around students.
story: We International Education & Visa began in Sydney in 2023 with one simple goal: to give international students honest, easy-to-understand help with studying in Australia.
Today we work with registered education providers (CRICOS) and with registered migration agent partners, and our team includes a PIER-certified Qualified Education Agent Counsellor (QEAC).
facts: We work with CRICOS-registered education providers
how: Tell us what you want to study, where, your past study and your budget.
We look at current courses and confirm details such as fees, campus and start dates with the school.
We explain the options in plain words. The choice is always yours.
Applications, documents for your school, homestay and health cover links, and what to do when you arrive.
not: We are not a migration agent and do not give visa advice. We refer visa questions to a registered migration agent.
We do not promise a place, a visa, a job or any outcome. Schools decide admission and the government decides visas.
We do not ask for passports or private documents in a first message.
people: Our website assistant, Mia, is an AI. She answers general questions in many languages and passes your message to our team. Our team speaks Thai and English, so a reply from a person is in Thai or English.
disclaimer: Images are illustrative and may be AI-generated; they do not show a specific provider, campus or student testimonial.
